description: Source code for the mod_vhostdb plugin in lighttpd, implementing virtual hosts mapping from a backend database with caching and periodic cleanup.

methods.name: vhostdb_cache_entry_init
methods.description: Initializes a vhostdb_cache_entry with server name and document root buffers.

methods.name: vhostdb_cache_free
methods.description: Frees the entire vhostdb_cache, including its splay tree.

methods.name: vhostdb_cache_init
methods.description: Initializes vhostdb_cache with options, setting max_age.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_cache_query
methods.description: Queries the cache for a virtual host entry based on request authority.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_cache_insert
methods.description: Inserts a cache entry into the splay tree cache.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default plugin configuration, including backend and cache options.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_handle_request_reset
methods.description: Resets plugin context for a request.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_error_500
methods.description: Returns a 500 Internal Server Error response.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_found
methods.description: Handles a found virtual host entry, setting server name and document root.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_handle_docroot
methods.description: Main handler for determining the document root based on virtual host cache or backend query.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_tag_old_entries
methods.description: Tags cache entries that are older than max_age for cleanup.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_periodic_cleanup
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of expired cache entries.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_periodic
methods.description: Trigger function called periodically to cleanup cache entries.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting function pointers and plugin info.
